# 5 Useful Sleeping Tips

## 1. Maintain a Consistent Sleep Schedule
- Helps regulate your body's internal clock
- Makes it easier to fall asleep and wake up naturally
- Improves overall sleep quality and daytime alertness
- Reduces the risk of sleep disorders

## 2. Create a Cool, Dark, and Quiet Bedroom
- Darkness triggers melatonin production, the sleep hormone
- Cool temperatures (around 65-68°F) promote better sleep
- Minimal noise prevents sleep disruptions and fragmentation
- A calm environment reduces anxiety and stress

## 3. Avoid Screens 30-60 Minutes Before Bed
- Blue light from devices suppresses melatonin production
- Screen stimulation keeps your brain in an alert state
- Reduces mental activity needed to transition to sleep
- Helps prevent racing thoughts that interfere with falling asleep

## 4. Limit Caffeine and Heavy Meals Before Bed
- Caffeine can remain in your system for 5-6 hours
- Heavy meals cause discomfort and digestive issues during sleep
- These substances can cause frequent nighttime awakenings
- Avoiding them promotes deeper, more restful sleep

## 5. Exercise Regularly (But Not Before Bed)
- Physical activity reduces stress and anxiety
- Exercise promotes deeper, more restorative sleep stages
- Daytime activity helps regulate circadian rhythm
- Evening exercise can be stimulating, so timing matters
